[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about preplanning of duck farming?
Answer: Suggested to first selection of land with pond area secondly selection of breed like khaki campbell for egg production and white pekin for meat are the other popular breed ,these are prolific layers which can give up to 300 eggs per laying cycle. these birds are very much suitable for rural development programmes for sustainable economical development in rural areas. among the egg laying breeds, khaki campbell is the best producer. individual egg production of almost an egg a day in this breed for well over twelve months has been recorded and flock averages in excess of 300 eggs per duck per year are not uncommon. khaki campbell ducks weigh about 2 to 2.2 kg and drakes 2.2 to 2.4 kg. egg weight varies from 65 to 75 gm., white pekin . thirdly housing ....ducks do not require elaborate houses. the house should be well ventilated, dry and rat proof. the roof may be of shed type, gable or half round. it may have solid or wire floors. the wire floors are not popular with breeders. under semi intensive system the house should have easy access to outside run as the ducks prefer to be outdoors during the day time and even during winter or rains. generally the proportion of night shelter to outside run is 1/4:3/4. the run should gently slope away from the houses to provide drainage. normally a continuous water channel of size 50 cm wide and 15 20 cm. deep is constructed at the far end, on both sides, parallel to the night shelter, in the rearing or layer house fourthly ...feeding and health care...ducks may be grown on dry mash, a combination of dry and wet mash or pellets. ducks prefer wet mash due to difficulties in swallowing dry mash. the pellet feeding, though slightly costly, has distinct advantages such as saving in amount of feed, minimum wastages, saving in labour, convenience and improvement in sanitary conditions. ducks are good foragers. the use of range, pond or supplementary green feed, reduces the feed cost. fifthly ...health care...breeder males and females are selected when they are around 6 8 weeks of age. for maximum fertility drakes should be older by 4 5 weeks than females. in flock mating a male female ratio of 1:6 to 1:8 is satisfactory with layer types of ducks while ratio should be narrower for meat type of ducks.
Details: Category=Expert Agricultural Advice

Query: Asking about storage of potatos for seed purpose.?

Query: Asking about pollination process of pointed gourd?
Answer: Imply break off the male flower, and hold it over the female flower and "tap" the pollen from the male flowerthe final step is placing a bag over the pollinated female flower. this prevents the flower from being cross pollinated by insects that have visited other types of gourds.we use 3 inch by 5 inch draw string muslin cloth bags. the bags slide easily over the flower and you simply pull the drawstring snug, no need to tie.

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about nursery management of cauliflower?
Answer: Told him to select a sunny area with well drained friable light soil rich in organic matter. bring the soil into fine tilth and prepare the bed of 1 meter width and of convenient length. raise it to 10 15 cm above ground level. for an area of 10 meter square in the bed, mix 20 kg sand or silt and 20 kg compost. to make the soil free from soil borne disease causing pathogens drench the bed with formalin @ 40 ml/litre of water so as to saturate the soil upto a depth of 10 15 cm.keep in covered, immediately after treating, with polythene sheet or gunny bag paper for 2 days. uncover the soil and get it loosened and leave it as such for 3 4 days. treat the dry seeds with thiram @ 3g/kg seeds against seed borne pathogens. sow the seeds thinly in u shaped furrows spaced at 2.5 cm and at a depth of 1 2 cm.cover the seeds immediately with a thin layer of sand mixed with well dried and sieved cow dung. cover the seeds with a thin layer of straw. the seedlings get ready for transplanting when they attain 10 15 cm height or become 30 35 days old.

Query: Query regarding  incorporate  colocasia in cattle feed?
Answer: Told him to incorporate colocasia in cattle feed after processing, without reaching the toxic level [ threshold limit ] molasses or mineral supplement can be added to increase the palatability of the feed [ colocasia contain calcium oxalate which cause severe pain & irritation in smooth muscle , affecting the larynx & pharynx , so it should be used after processingi.e bioling , drying & crussing  etc ]

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about pm kisan pension scheme?
Answer: Told him each subscriber under this scheme will receive a minimum assured pension of ?3,000 per month once they turn 60. if the subscriber dies before the age of 60, his or her spouse will get a chance to continue the scheme.pm sym is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme on a 50:50 basis where a prescribed age specific contribution shall be made by the beneficiary and a matching contribution by the central government.the enrollment has already started. eligible subscribers can enroll by visiting their nearest common service centres (cscs). a savings bank account or jan dhan account and an aadhaar card are needed to open this pension account.the monthly contribution by a worker joining the scheme at the age of 18, will be ?55, with matching contributions from the government. the contributions will rise with higher age. the contribution amount for the first month shall be paid in cash for which subscribers will be provided with a receipt.

Query: Asking about application of plant growth regulator for brinjal?

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Query regarding kisan credit card?
Answer: All agricultural farmers are eligible to benefit from the kisan credit card scheme. this includes farmers who own their own land, tenant farmers, share croppers and lessees. the national crop insurance scheme covers the crops eligible for kcc. the scheme offers some protection to the farmers in a poor crop season. the biggest advantage of this scheme is the simplicity of the credit process. this translates into quicker and timely availability of funds for the farmers. there is minimal paperwork and documentation involved. there is a lot of flexibility in the repayment tenure of the kisan credit card loan. there is also a possibility of extending the repayment period in case of a bad crop turnout due to natural calamities. farmers are also offered subvention for timely and prompt repayments. it ensures assured availability of financial resources at affordable interest rates. it provides insurance coverage (personal accident and asset) for the recipient of the kisan credit cards. it provides facility to withdraw cash as per the farmer's requirements.
Details: Category=Expert Agricultural Advice

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Farmer asked a query regarding irrigation management in potato.?
Answer: The furrow method of irrigation has to be adopted. three irrigations should be applied, first at 25 das (stolon formation stage), second at 60 das (tuber formation stage) and third at 80 das (tuber development stage) after emergence of sprouts. in case of application of mulching materials in furrows, only two irrigations are to be applied at 25 and 60 das after emergence of sprouts. at the time of application of irrigation, care should be taken not to submerge the ridges completely.

Query: Asking about control of bacterial wilt of brinjal?
Answer: Do ooze test for confirmation. dip the infected leaf/ branch in clear water for half an hour. if white particles comes out then it is bacterial infection. then spray strptomycin or crystocyclin 3 times at 7 days interval mixing 1 gram in 5 liters of water. if no white particles comes out then it is fungal infection. for that spray saaf 3 times at 5 days interval mixing 2 gram in 1 liter of water.

Query: Asking about how and what amount of fertilizer should be use in arecanut.?
Answer: Please use the recommended doses of fertilizer in two equal split doses  urea 100 gram, super 120 gram and potash 110 gram and borax 50 gram in ring method 1 meter away from the plant and 10 15 cm depth. fertilizers should be mixed together and apply once in the month of november and next dose should be apply in the month of march/april. you can also apply dry masturd cake or neem cake along with the fertilizer.

Query: Query regarding management of wilt in brinjal field.?
Answer: First of all you have to do the bacterial test. for that cut a piece of twig from the affected plant, put into a glass of clean water and keep it for 30 minutes. after that if you have noticed that the water become yellowish white then you have to apply streptomycin/ streptocyclin 2gram/10liter of water in the root portion  and if the water remain same then you can use any fungicide like captaf/glyodin/ carboxin/captan 3 gram/liter of water.

Query: Asking about the cultural practices of sali paddy.?
Answer: Advised him to prepare the nursery bed of 1.25 width, 15 cm height, 10 metre length,and apply urea 80 gm, ssp 80 gm, mop 80 gm to this bed .sow one kg seeds to this bed after treating  the seeds with captan or captaf @ 2 gm per kg seeds. prepare the main field properly by ploughing and levelling and apply urea 6 kg, ssp 33 kg, mop 6.5 kg per bigha at the time last land preparation, top dress 6 kg urea after 30 days of transplanting.again top dress urea @ 6 kg, mop 6.5 kg per bigha at the time of panicle initiation stage.

Query: Asking about the cultural practices of boro paddy.?
Answer: Advised him to select suitable varieties like pac 835, arize 6444,boro 1, boro 9 etc. and treat the seeds with captan or captaf @ 2 gm. per kg/litre of water. sow the seeds in nursery bed and when it attains 25 days old transplant in main field. apply urea 10 kg, ssp 50 kg, mop 6 kg per bigha at the time of last land preparation. again after 30 days apply urea 5 kg per bigha. at the time of panicle initiation stage apply urea 5 kg, mop 6 kg per bigha.

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Soil management in organic farming?
Answer: Important goals include: the protection and, if possible, improvement of soil physical condition so that the soil supports healthy plants and soil dwelling organisms and has the ability to resist and recover from stresses like flooding or aggressive tillage; the maintenance of soil buffering capacity to minimize environmental degradation caused by soil loss or soils' failure to filter nutrients or degrade harmful compounds; and increased water and nutrient use efficiency by increasing biological fixation and retention of needed nutrients while reducing their loss from the system to the extent possible. organic farming systems are designed with the aim of maintaining nutrients in organic reservoirs or in bioavailable mineral forms instead of just supplying nutrients through frequent fertilizer additions. this is achieved by cycling nutrients through organic reservoirs. soil fertility is improved by organic matter management
Details: Category=Expert Agricultural Advice

Query: Asking about soil health card?
Answer: Told him that soil health card  is a printed report that a farmer will be handed over for each of his holdings. it will contain the status of his soil with respect to 12 parameters, namely nitrogen,phosphorous,potassium (macro nutrients) ; sulphur (secondary  nutrient) ; zinc, iron, copper, manganese, boron (micro   nutrients) ; and ph, electrical conductivity, organic carbon (physical parameters). based on this, the soil health card will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.

Query: Asking about soil health card?
Answer: Soil health card is a printed report that a farmer will be handed over for each of his holdings. it will contain the status of his soil with respect to 12 parameters, namely n,p,k (macro nutrients); s (secondary  nutrient); zn, fe, cu, mn, bo (micro   nutrients); and ph, ec, oc (physical parameters). based on this, the shc will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about soil health card?
Answer: Soil health card is a printed report that a farmer will be handed over for each of his holdings. it will contain the status of his soil with respect to 12 parameters, namely nitrogen,phosphorous,potassium (macro nutrients) ; sulphur (secondary  nutrient) ; zinc, iron, copper, manganese, boron (micro   nutrients) ; and ph, electrical conductivity, organic carbon (physical parameters). based on this, the soil health card will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.
Details: Category=Expert Agricultural Advice

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about the cultivation practice of mushroom?
Answer: Material required  production room, grass cutter, paddy straw, spawn, polypropylene bags. procedure: raw material paddy straw, chopping the straw into 2 3cm, soaking in water for 5 hours, boiling the straw for 1 hours, drain off excess water, drying the straw upto 60 70 % moisture, prepared the bags with five layers of straw and four layers of spawn and pinning the bags , kept in semi dark room, spawn running and covering the outer side of the straw with white mycellium , remove the bags, straw beds are kept in main cultivation room, watering daily, growing of mushroom, harvest the mushrooms, marketed freshly or after drying.

Answer: First of all you have to do the bacterial test. for that you have to cut a piece of twig from the affected plant and then put in to a glass of clean water, keep it like that for about 30 minutes. after that if you noticed that the water become yellowish white then drench the soil with streptomycin or streptocyclin 2gram/10 liter of water after roughing out the severely affected plant and also apply in the un affected plants 3 times a 3 days interval in the evening time in the absence of rain.

Query: Asking about procedure of straw treatment in the mushroom production?

Query: Query regarding plant protection in brinjal.?
Answer: First you have to do the ooze test   dip the affected part in a glass of water and keep it for 30 minutes. if ooze comes out and the water become yellowish white, then spray also apply tetracyclin/ streptocyclin (1gram/5 lit of water), near the root zone 3 times at 5 days interval and if ooze don't show in the water, and the water remains clean then spray and also apply saaf (2 gram/lit of water) near the root zone 3 times at 5 days interval.

Query: Asking about the method of mango grafting.?
Answer: Advised to grow root stock from the seed of mother plant.use the 1 yr old seedling as root stock.take a branch from the mother plant of 1 yr old for scion.remove the leaf from the root stock and give a straight cut about .5 inch.give a slenting cut at both the sides of scion and inser it into the root stock.tie with grafting tape.after 1.5 months new leaf will come out.plant it in the main field/

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Query regarding fishery cum duckery?
Answer: The shed ( farm house )  for the duck preferably should be made over the pond . the size & shape of the shed is depend upon the the size & shape of the pond ( rectangular . elongated , square , etc )  , the such shed give a shadow to the fish in  rearing pond ( either hatchery / stoking pond ) . the excreta of duck is the direct source of fish feed which are regularly fall over the pond water minimising the labour cost , besides such constructed shed give protection to the duck from vector ( mice, rat  etc ) & wild animals ( fox, jackel etc ). the feed supply to the fish can be tied directly on the post which are  made for for the duck shed , thus manipulation of feed bag can be done easily from the inner portion of the duck shed . the investment of capital is depend upon the type of shed

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about harvesting time of cinnamon.?
Answer: The harvesting starts from 4th or 5th year after planting. the shoots are cut for the extraction of bark once in may and again in november. as soon as rain ceases, cutting of shoots for peeling of bark is commenced. after cutting, young shoots spring up from the stump which will be ready for removal in subsequent season within 18 months. the bark is peeled from the selected shoots of 18 to 24 months old, which are usually one metre long and 1 to 2 cm thick.  shoots ready for peeling are removed from the stumps and terminal ends of shoots are also removed. peeling is done by knives after scraping off the outer bark.

Query: Query regarding  artificial insemination of pig?
Answer: Artificial insemination  can be perform in pig , but there are some restriction , since sow is prolific [to obtain  high litter size ] , natural mating is mostly preferred with selective boar / the numbers of ova arelase at a time in case of sow , a large volume is required to fertilize the ova , so 2 nd mating is done in case of sow to get large litter size , drawback is that all ova are not release at a time & they do not  reach the ampullary region within specific time , so 2 nd mating is necessary , artificial insemination is sow can also be practise in sow  with  sofisticated technique , where large volume of sperm will required, with large straw & extender [  probably sofisticated  a.i will required in a sow in different time within two days of oestrous , already a. i is introduce in some state & in near future a.i can be performed  here also by following specific technique& method , research is going on in this field

Query: Asking about control of insect infestation before transplanting to main field?
Answer: Root dip treatment of seedlings: the uprooted seedlings are washed and then the root portion is dipped in solution of chlorpyriphos (2 ml/lit of water) along with 1% urea (10g/lit of water) for 3 hours as protective measure against stem borer, gall midge and hoppers. alternatively  phorate or diazinon 1g/sq.m is to be applied in the seed bed 5 to 7 days before uprooting of seedlings or spray chlorpyriphos 20 ec @ 0.02% in the seed bed 5 7 days before uprooting.

Query: Asking about control of nematode?
Answer: Pre treat the suckers with 40 g carbofuran 3g. if pre treatment is not done, apply 40 g of carbofuran around each plant one month after planting (refer selection and pre treatment for alternate technology) or pare and dip the corm in 0.75% monocrotophos solution, shade dry and plant. then grow sunhemp after 45th day and incorporate one month later. press mud application @ 15 t per ha one month after planting and neem cake 1.5 t per ha one month after planting will also control the nematode infestation.

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about farming of quil (wanted to farming just now)?
Answer: Recommended to 1.japanese quail and bobwhite quails are the domesticated varieties of quail. japanese quails are hardy, grows faster, has a short generation interval and is precocious. the meat is a delicacy. specific lines developed for egg production as well as meat production are available. 2.japanese quails are hardier. they seldom have disease problems. therefore, there is no need for routine immunization programme as with other poultry species. one major disease that affects japanese quail is quail enteritis. this disease can be treated using appropriate antibiotics under veterinarian's advice. 3.quails reach sexual maturity at about six weeks of age and weigh 120 g. adults require 150 180 cm 2 per quail in laying cage. a feeder space of 2 3 cm per quail and water space of 2 cm has to be provided. for laying flock a photoperiod of 16 hours is desirable for good egg production. layer quails may be provided with a mash containing 22% protein and 2650 k cal/kg of me. japanese quails reproduce well in all seasons. the eggs are laid from evening, the peak being between 6.30   7.30 p.m. the eggs laid during second year of lay are very much fewer than first year. quail egg weighs around 10 g and is characterised by a variety of colour pattern ranging from dark brown, blue and white to buff each mottled with black, brown and blue. the egg shell is very thin and therefore breaks easily.

Query: Farmer asking query regarding control of damping off in nursery bed.?
